title: End-to-end prostate lesion segmentation and detection from undersampled diffusion-weighted MRI
title_zh: 从欠采样弥散加权MRI进行端到端前列腺病灶分割与检测

paragraphs.en: Automated prostate lesion detection from diffusion-weighted MR imaging (DWI) conventionally relies on reconstructed images and does not fully use all acquisition information. We present an end-to-end network that uses complex multicoil DWI data and coil sensitivity information for prostate lesion segmentation. We evaluated its robustness to undersampling and added noise, its performance in patient-level detection, and the contributions of data consistency and training strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 基于弥散加权磁共振成像（DWI）的前列腺病灶自动检测通常依赖于重建后的图像，未能充分利用所有采集信息。 我们提出了一种端到端网络，该网络利用多线圈DWI复数数据和线圈敏感性信息进行前列腺病灶分割。 我们评估了该网络对欠采样和附加噪声的鲁棒性、其在患者级别检测中的表现，以及数据一致性和训练策略的贡献。

sents.zh: 我们评估了该网络对欠采样和附加噪声的鲁棒性、其在患者级别检测中的表现，以及数据一致性和训练策略的贡献。

paragraphs.en: We included 269 fastMRI prostate examinations with additional voxel-level lesion annotations based on the released DWI PIRADS scores. Of these, 64 examinations contained PIRADS 4 or 5 lesions. The proposed network, VarNet-Seg, consists of a k-space variational network (VarNet) with six variational cascades and an image-space 3D segmentation U-Net and is trained end to end on complex multicoil b50 and b1000 data. Comparator models used the same segmentation architecture with fully coil-combined images (CC-Seg), fixed root-sum-of-squares reconstruction (RSS-Seg), or fixed SENSE reconstruction (SENSE-Seg). VarNet-Seg (no DC) retained the proposed architecture with data consistency disabled. We performed ablations with end-to-end training and data consistency enabled or disabled. We evaluated lesion segmentation using Dice and patient-level detection using AUROC in five-fold cross-validation with full sampling, simulated undersampling, added noise, or both.
paragraphs.zh: 我们纳入了 269 例 fastMRI 前列腺检查，并基于公开的 DWI PIRADS 评分添加了体素级的病灶标注。 其中，64 例检查包含 PIRADS 4 或 5 级病灶。 所提出的网络 VarNet-Seg 由一个包含六个变分级联的 k 空间变分网络（VarNet）和一个图像空间的三维分割 U-Net 组成，并在复数多线圈 b50 和 b1000 数据上进行端到端训练。 对比模型使用相同的分割架构，输入分别为全线圈合并图像（CC-Seg）、固定的平方和根重建图像（RSS-Seg）或固定的 SENSE 重建图像（SENSE-Seg）。 VarNet-Seg（无 DC）保留了所提出的架构，但禁用了数据一致性模块。 我们进行了消融实验，分别启用或禁用端到端训练和数据一致性。 我们在五折交叉验证中，分别在完整采样、模拟欠采样、添加噪声或两者兼有的条件下，使用 Dice 系数评估病灶分割，并使用 AUROC 评估患者级别的检测性能。

paragraphs.en: VarNet-Seg achieved the highest Dice at every undersampling level. At eight-fold acceleration, Dice was 0.22 for VarNet-Seg, 0.14 for SENSE-Seg and 0.16 for VarNet-Seg (no DC). The paired difference from SENSE-Seg was 0.08 (95% CI, 0.04–0.11). VarNet-Seg (frozen) and VarNet-Seg (frozen, no DC) achieved Dice of 0.17 and 0.12, respectively, with the matched ablations supporting contributions from both end-to-end training and data consistency. With full sampling, VarNet-Seg and RSS-Seg performed similarly (0.40 vs 0.39). Removing data consistency reduced Dice under acceleration in all training strategies. Patient-level AUROC decreased from 0.75 with full sampling to 0.63 at eight-fold acceleration; corresponding RSS-Seg AUROCs were 0.76 and 0.64. VarNet-Seg inference took 29 ms per volume, compared with 4 ms for SENSE-Seg.

paragraphs.en: The proposed multicoil network improved prostate lesion segmentation under simulated undersampling compared to conventional models. Matched ablations supported contributions from both end-to-end training and data consistency. Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether this approach can be used clinically in accelerated prostate DWI.
paragraphs.zh: 与传统模型相比，所提出的多线圈网络在模拟欠采样条件下改善了前列腺病灶分割。 匹配的消融实验支持端到端训练与数据一致性两者的贡献。 需要前瞻性评估来确定该方法能否在加速前列腺DWI中用于临床。

paragraphs.en: Prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers in men, and its increasing global burden places growing demands on diagnostic services James et al. (2024) . Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has become central to diagnosis and biopsy planning by identifying suspicious lesions and guiding targeted tissue sampling Kasivisvanathan et al. (2018) ; Turkbey et al. (2019) . However, long examination times and limited scanner capacity constrain access to prostate MRI Ng et al. (2025) . Shorter protocols would allow more patients to be examined with existing capacity, provided that they preserve the information needed to detect and localize lesions. For automated lesion assessment, we address the separation of reconstruction and segmentation by training both stages jointly to preserve lesion information under reduced sampling and added noise.
paragraphs.zh: 前列腺癌是男性中最常见的癌症之一，其全球疾病负担的不断加重对诊断服务提出了越来越高的要求 James et al. (2024)。 磁共振成像（MRI）通过识别可疑病灶并引导靶向组织取样，已成为诊断和活检规划的核心手段 Kasivisvanathan et al. (2018)；Turkbey et al. (2019)。 然而，检查耗时长和扫描仪容量有限限制了前列腺 MRI 的可及性 Ng et al. (2025)。 在保留检测和定位病灶所需信息的前提下，更短的扫描方案将使现有设备容量能够检查更多患者。 针对自动化病灶评估，我们通过联合训练重建与分割两个阶段，来解决二者的分离问题，从而在采样减少和噪声增加的情况下保留病灶信息。

paragraphs.en: Biparametric protocols already shorten examinations by omitting contrast-enhanced imaging, without loss of diagnostic performance when image quality is adequate Ng et al. (2025) . They consist of T2-weighted and diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), including derived apparent diffusion coefficient maps, which provide the anatomical and diffusion information used in PIRADS assessment Turkbey et al. (2019) . Further reductions in scan time require more efficient acquisition, for example by collecting fewer k-space samples or reducing the number of signal averages. Both make the subsequent reconstruction harder, because images must then be recovered from incomplete or noisier measurements. One common approach, parallel imaging, uses differences in receiver-coil sensitivity to reconstruct undersampled data, but the associated loss of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) limits acceleration Pruessmann et al. (1999) ; Griswold et al. (2002) .
paragraphs.zh: 双参数方案已能通过省略对比增强成像来缩短检查时间，且在图像质量充分时不会损失诊断性能 Ng et al. (2025) 。 双参数方案由T2加权成像和弥散加权成像（DWI）组成，包括衍生的表观弥散系数图，为PIRADS评估提供解剖学和弥散信息 Turkbey et al. (2019) 。 要进一步缩短扫描时间，则需要更高效的采集方式，例如采集更少的k空间样本或减少信号平均次数。 这两种方式都会使后续重建更加困难，因为此时必须从不完整或噪声更大的测量数据中恢复图像。 并行成像是常用方法，它利用接收线圈敏感度的差异来重建欠采样数据，但由此带来的信噪比（SNR）损失限制了加速倍数 Pruessmann et al. (1999) ；Griswold et al. (2002) 。

paragraphs.en: A similar constraint arises in low-field MRI, where less expensive hardware could broaden access and modern systems are being investigated for prostate imaging Koonjoo et al. (2021) ; Segeroth et al. (2025) . Lower field strength reduces the available MR signal, increasing the relative influence of noise, particularly in high- b b DWI where diffusion weighting further attenuates the signal. Additional averaging restores SNR, but at the cost of longer acquisitions Koonjoo et al. (2021) .
paragraphs.zh: 类似的约束也出现在低场磁共振成像中，那里更便宜的硬件可以扩大可及性，且目前正研究用于前列腺成像的现代系统 Koonjoo et al. (2021) ; Segeroth et al. (2025) 。 更低的场强会降低可用的磁共振信号，增加噪声的相对影响，在高 b b 值弥散加权成像中尤其如此，因为弥散加权会进一步衰减信号。 额外的平均可以恢复信噪比，但代价是更长的采集时间 Koonjoo et al. (2021) 。

paragraphs.en: Established approaches to automated prostate lesion assessment from these measurements operate on reconstructed images, with reconstruction and lesion analysis treated as separate tasks Saha et al. (2024) ; van Lohuizen et al. (2024) . The analysis network thus receives images after coil combination, without direct access to the underlying complex measurements or the ability to influence their reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 从这些测量数据自动化评估前列腺病灶的既有方法均在重建图像上进行，重建与病灶分析被视为相互独立的任务 Saha 等人 （2024）；van Lohuizen 等人（2024）。 因此，分析网络接收的是线圈组合之后的图像，既无法直接访问底层的复数测量数据，也无法影响其重建过程。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, training both reconstruction and segmentation simultaneously allows lesion annotations to guide reconstruction, giving both stages a shared objective Sun et al. (2019) . Errors in the final segmentation can then influence how the complex diffusion data are combined and refined, so that reconstruction is trained to support lesion delineation. However, improvements in reconstructed image quality do not necessarily translate into better lesion detection van Lohuizen et al. (2024) . Optimizing reconstruction for the downstream task rather than for image quality addresses this mismatch directly.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，同时训练重建与分割可以让病灶标注指导重建，使两个阶段拥有共同的目标 Sun et al. (2019) 。 最终分割中的误差可以进而影响复杂扩散数据的组合与精炼方式，从而使重建被训练得能够支持病灶勾画。 然而，重建图像质量的提升并不一定会转化为更好的病灶检测效果 van Lohuizen et al. (2024) 。 针对下游任务而非图像质量来优化重建，可以直接解决这一不匹配问题。

paragraphs.en: Here, we present VarNet-Seg, an end-to-end variational network that combines multicoil DWI reconstruction and 3D prostate lesion segmentation in a single model. Using complex low- and high- b b data from the 3 T fastMRI Prostate dataset with additional voxel-level annotations Tibrewala et al. (2024) , we compare it with segmentation models using fixed RSS or SENSE reconstruction (RSS-Seg and SENSE-Seg), a coil-combined image model (CC-Seg) and VarNet-Seg (no DC), a matched variant with data consistency disabled. Variational networks provide this connection by alternating learned image refinement with data-consistency updates in k-space Hammernik et al. (2018) ; Sriram et al. (2020) . These updates relate intermediate image estimates to the retained measurements, allowing learned suppression of aliasing and noise to be guided by the input data.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们提出 VarNet-Seg，这是一种端到端的变分网络，将多线圈 DWI 重建与 3D 前列腺病灶分割结合在单一模型中。 我们使用来自 3T fastMRI Prostate 数据集并附带额外体素级标注的复数低 b 值和高 b 值数据 Tibrewala et al. (2024)，将其与使用固定 RSS 或 SENSE 重建的分割模型（RSS-Seg 和 SENSE-Seg）、线圈合并图像模型（CC-Seg）以及 VarNet-Seg (no DC)（一种禁用数据一致性的匹配变体）进行比较。 变分网络通过在 k 空间中交替进行学习到的图像细化与数据一致性更新来提供这种联系 Hammernik et al. (2018)；Sriram et al. (2020)。 这些更新将中间图像估计与保留的测量数据相关联，使得由输入数据引导的学习到的混叠与噪声抑制成为可能。

paragraphs.en: By evaluating full sampling, simulated undersampling, added noise and their combination, we test how far task-trained reconstruction can sustain lesion analysis as data availability and SNR decrease, and whether improved delineation is accompanied by better patient-level detection.

paragraphs.en: This retrospective study included 269 examinations from the public fastMRI prostate dataset Tibrewala et al. (2024) . Of the 312 released examinations, 43 were excluded because diffusion raw data were incomplete or missing. Detailed information about the dataset are available in the accompanying publication. In brief, images were acquired on two 3 T systems (MAGNETOM Vida, Siemens Healthineers, Germany) using single-shot echo-planar imaging at b = 50 b=50 and 1000 ​ s / mm 2 1000\,\mathrm{s/mm^{2}} . The protocol comprised three diffusion directions, four and twelve averages per direction for the two b b -values, respectively, two-fold parallel imaging, and 2.0 × 2.0 × 3.0 2.0\times 2.0\times 3.0 mm voxels. The source study had institutional review board approval with a waiver of informed consent Tibrewala et al. (2024) .
paragraphs.zh: 本回顾性研究纳入了公开的 fastMRI 前列腺数据集 Tibrewala et al. paragraphs.en: The proposed model, VarNet-Seg, uses six variational cascades for k-space processing Hammernik et al. (2018) ; Sriram et al. (2020) with an image-space 3D segmentation U-Net Çiçek et al. (2016) as a single architecture trained end to end for prostate lesion segmentation. The variational module was adapted to process the complex multicoil b ​ 50 b50 and b ​ 1000 b1000 data jointly. Each cascade uses a 3D residual CNN that receives the real and imaginary components of both contrasts and learns features across neighboring slices. Image refinement alternates with soft data-consistency updates at the sampled k-space locations. Each cascade has separate CNN weights, a learned residual scale and a learned data-consistency weight constrained between zero and one. After SENSE coil combination Pruessmann et al. (1999) of the processed k-space data, a central crop encompassing the prostate and periprostatic tissue is passed to the image-space U-Net to predict background and the three PIRADS classes.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的模型 VarNet-Seg 使用六个变分级联进行 k 空间处理 Hammernik et al. (2018) ；Sriram et al. (2020)，并结合图像空间的 3D 分割 U-Net Çiçek et al. paragraphs.en: Six comparator models were chosen to distinguish the contributions of the input representation, reconstruction training strategy and data consistency. CC-Seg receives the complex images reconstructed from the physical receive coils directly. RSS-Seg uses fixed root-sum-of-squares (RSS) magnitude reconstructions from the twelve virtual coils in k-space. SENSE-Seg uses fixed complex SENSE reconstructions from the same virtual coils and sensitivity maps as VarNet-Seg, with missing k-space samples set to zero. VarNet-Seg (no DC) retains the complete reconstruction and segmentation architecture but omits the consistency updates. VarNet-Seg (frozen) and VarNet-Seg (frozen, no DC) use a separately pretrained reconstruction VarNet that is held fixed while the image-space U-Net is trained. Together, the four VarNet variants compare end-to-end and separate training with data consistency enabled or disabled within the same base architecture. All models use the same segmentation U-Net, with input channels adapted to magnitude or complex images. Corresponding segmentation U-Net layers were initialized identically across models within each fold.
paragraphs.zh: 选择了六个对比模型，以区分输入表示、重建训练策略和数据一致性的贡献。 CC-Seg 直接接收由物理接收线圈重建得到的复数图像。 RSS-Seg 使用由十二个虚拟线圈在 k 空间中得到的固定根平方和（RSS）幅度重建。 SENSE-Seg 使用与 VarNet-Seg 相同的虚拟线圈和灵敏度图得到的固定复数 SENSE 重建，缺失的 k 空间采样点被置为零。 VarNet-Seg（无 DC）保留了完整的重建与分割架构，但省略了一致性更新。 VarNet-Seg（冻结）和 VarNet-Seg（冻结、无 DC）使用单独预训练的重建 VarNet，在训练图像空间 U-Net 时保持其固定。 这四个 VarNet 变体共同比较了在相同基础架构下启用或禁用数据一致性时的端到端训练与分离式训练。 所有模型使用相同的分割 U-Net，其输入通道根据幅度图像或复数图像进行调整。 在每个折内，各模型的分割 U-Net 对应层以相同方式初始化。

paragraphs.en: Models were trained and evaluated using patient-level five-fold cross-validation stratified by highest annotated lesion grade. All models used the same patient partitions, with a separate validation subset within each training fold. Segmentation training used AdamW with cosine learning-rate decay and early stopping based on validation Dice with full sampling. The same checkpoint was used for all evaluation settings within each fold.

Models with fixed reconstructions were trained with the segmentation loss alone. Training augmentation included extensive k-space augmentation, namely spatial transformations, gamma adjustment, random or equispaced undersampling at two- to eight-fold acceleration, and added noise. Spatial transformations were applied jointly to coil images, sensitivity maps and labels. Architecture, loss weights and optimization settings are detailed in the Supplement.

paragraphs.en: Performance was evaluated with full sampling ( R = 1 R=1 ), simulated undersampling, added noise and their combination. For undersampling, equispaced phase-encoding lines were omitted with a fully sampled central band at accelerations from two- to sixteen-fold, as detailed in Table S3 . This simulates reduced sampling relevant to faster acquisitions; R R denotes the nominal retrospective undersampling factor, not a measured scan-time reduction. Sampling patterns were shared across coils, b b -values and slices within each examination and were identical for all models. Complex Gaussian noise was added to k-space before undersampling, with signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) from 30 to − 20 -20 dB. Combined experiments evaluated up to sixteen-fold acceleration at SNRs of 20, 10 and 5 dB. Noise levels were defined using signal power pooled across coils, slices and both b b -values. Undersampling and noise were applied to the preprocessed k-space, with sensitivity maps and normalization kept as derived from the fully sampled data.
paragraphs.zh: 性能评估采用全采样（ R = 1 R=1 ）、模拟欠采样、加噪以及二者的组合。 在欠采样中，以等间隔省略相位编码线，并保持中心区域完全采样，加速倍数从两倍到十六倍，详见表 S3 。 这模拟了与更快采集相关的采样减少； R R 表示标称的回顾性欠采样因子，而非实际测得的扫描时间缩短。 采样模式在同一次检查内的各线圈、各 b b 值和各层面之间共享，且对所有模型完全相同。 在欠采样之前向 k 空间加入复高斯噪声，信噪比（SNR）范围为 30 到 − 20 -20 dB。 联合实验评估了在 SNR 为 20、10 和 5 dB 时高达十六倍的加速。 噪声水平使用跨线圈、跨层面以及两个 b b 值汇总的信号功率来定义。 欠采样和加噪应用于预处理后的 k 空间，灵敏度图和归一化仍沿用由全采样数据得到的结果。

paragraphs.en: In this study we trained a novel end-to-end model which includes a variational network for k-space processing and 3D image-space network for lesion segmentation and detection on multicoil prostate DWI. Matched ablations supported contributions from both end-to-end training and data consistency.

paragraphs.en: Several prostate reconstruction studies have also investigated whether and how strong acceleration in general impacts the diagnostic value of prostate MRI. Johnson et al. evaluated image quality and lesion identification by radiologists after variational reconstruction of biparametric MRI Johnson et al. (2022) , and a more recent multireader study of T2-weighted MRI found no statistically significant reduction in AUROC up to six-fold acceleration, although AUROC did decrease as acceleration increased van Lohuizen et al. (2026) . However, such reader studies only demonstrate how a fixed reconstruction method performs under acceleration, not which reconstruction is most useful to an automated segmentation network. We address the latter by letting the segmentation objective shape the reconstruction during training.
paragraphs.zh: 多项前列腺重建研究还探讨了总体上的强加速是否以及如何影响前列腺MRI的诊断价值。 Johnson等人评估了双参数MRI变分重建后放射科医师的图像质量和病灶识别情况。Johnson等人 （2022），而一项较新的T2加权MRI多读者研究发现，在高达六倍加速时AUROC没有统计学上的显著下降，尽管随着加速增加AUROC确实有所下降。van Lohuizen等人（2026）。 然而，此类读者研究只能展示固定重建方法在加速下的表现，而不能说明哪种重建对自动化分割网络最有用。 我们通过让分割目标在训练过程中塑造重建来解决后一问题。

paragraphs.en: The comparison with SENSE-Seg shows that access to complex multicoil input alone does not explain the gain under undersampling, as this control shares the virtual coils, sensitivity maps and segmentation U-Net with VarNet-Seg. Relative to that matched control, the improvement reflects the addition of learned refinement together with its auxiliary reconstruction objective. The four matched VarNet variants further distinguish reconstruction training strategy from data consistency. End-to-end training improved Dice under undersampling relative to reconstruction-pretrained, frozen frontends both with and without data consistency. Data consistency also improved Dice under both training strategies. These comparisons support contributions from adapting reconstruction to the segmentation objective and from constraining the learned corrections with the acquired coil data.
paragraphs.zh: 与 SENSE-Seg 的对比表明，仅能访问复杂的多线圈输入并不能解释欠采样下的性能提升，因为该对照与 VarNet-Seg 共享相同的虚拟线圈、敏感性图和分割 U-Net。 相对于这一匹配对照，性能提升源于引入了可学习的细化模块及其辅助重建目标。 四个匹配的 VarNet 变体进一步区分了重建训练策略与数据一致性。 无论有无数据一致性，端到端训练在欠采样下的 Dice 指标均优于基于重建预训练且冻结前端的做法。 在两种训练策略下，数据一致性也均提升了 Dice 指标。 这些对比支持了以下两方面的贡献：使重建适配分割目标，以及利用采集到的线圈数据约束可学习的校正。

paragraphs.en: Dice and patient-level AUROC characterize different aspects of the predictions. Dice measures spatial agreement in patients with reference lesions, whereas the patient-level score ranks examinations by predicted lesion volume, counting correct and misplaced predictions alike and ignoring their confidence. Patient-level rankings therefore depend on both lesion burden and false-positive predictions. Van Lohuizen et al. found an analogous gap, where improved image similarity after T2-weighted reconstruction did not restore detection performance to that with full sampling van Lohuizen et al. (2024) .
paragraphs.zh: Dice 和患者级 AUROC 刻画了预测的不同方面。 Dice 衡量有参考病灶的患者中预测的空间一致性，而患者级评分则按预测的病灶体积对检查进行排序，将正确的和错位的预测同等计数，并忽略其置信度。 因此，患者级排名同时取决于病灶负荷和假阳性预测。 Van Lohuizen 等人发现了类似的差距：T2 加权重建后图像相似度有所提升，但检测性能并未恢复到全采样的水平 van Lohuizen et al. (2024) 。

paragraphs.en: Our study has several limitations. First, undersampling and noise were simulated retrospectively on data that had already been phase-corrected, averaged and coil-compressed, with sensitivity maps and normalization from the fully sampled data. The experiments compare robustness under controlled conditions but do not reproduce all real-world acquisition effects. Second, the cohort comes from one institution and one scanner model, with only 64 patients contributing to the primary Dice endpoint. Third, lesions were annotated by a single reader without histopathological confirmation.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究存在若干局限性。 首先，欠采样和噪声是在已经完成相位校正、平均和线圈压缩的数据上回溯性模拟的，且灵敏度图和归一化均来自全采样数据。 这些实验在受控条件下比较了鲁棒性，但并未复现所有真实采集中的效应。 其次，队列来自单一机构和单一型号的扫描仪，且仅有64名患者贡献了主要Dice终点。 第三，病灶由单一阅片者标注，未经组织病理学确认。

paragraphs.en: The natural next step is therefore an independent multicenter study on prospectively undersampled DWI, evaluated with Dice, lesion-level detection and calibrated patient-level scores against histopathology or clinical follow-up. Only such a study, timed over the complete acquisition and processing workflow, can show whether the gain survives in a genuinely shorter examination.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，下一步自然是开展一项独立的多中心研究，对前瞻性欠采样的DWI进行评估，以组织病理学或临床随访为参照，采用Dice系数、病灶级别检出以及经校准的患者级别评分进行评价。 只有这样一项覆盖完整采集与处理流程的研究，才能显示这一收益是否能在真正更短的检查时间中得以保留。

paragraphs.en: Our study supports an end-to-end approach to multicoil DWI for more robust prostate lesion segmentation under undersampling. The matched ablations support contributions from both data-consistency and end-to-end training. Independent prospective studies should establish whether this robustness translates into clinical benefit with accelerated prostate DWI.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究支持一种针对多线圈DWI的端到端方法，以在欠采样条件下实现更稳健的前列腺病灶分割。 匹配的消融实验证实了数据一致性和端到端训练两者的贡献。 应当开展独立的前瞻性研究，以确定这种稳健性能否在加速前列腺DWI中转化为临床获益。

paragraphs.en: GRAPPA reconstruction used a 5 × 5 5\times 5 kernel calibrated per slice from 32 central lines Griswold et al. (2002) . Coil compression was calibrated once per examination using all slices Zhang et al. (2013) . A low-resolution phase estimate from the central 32 × 32 32\times 32 k-space region, with a Hamming window, was subtracted from every coil data before complex arithmetic averaging across repetitions and diffusion directions Eichner et al. (2015) . ESPIRiT maps used a calibration width of 32 lines and were phase-aligned to the low-resolution b ​ 50 b50 SENSE image Uecker et al. (2014) .
paragraphs.zh: GRAPPA 重建采用 5 × 5 5\times 5 核，并基于每个切片的 32 条中心校准线进行校准 Griswold et al. (2002) 。 线圈压缩在每次检查中仅校准一次，使用所有切片的数据 Zhang et al. (2013) 。 在跨重复次数和扩散方向进行复数算术平均之前，从每个线圈数据中减去来自中心 32 × 32 32\times 32 k 空间区域（加汉明窗）的低分辨率相位估计 Eichner et al. (2015) 。 ESPIRiT 图使用的校准宽度为 32 条线，并与低分辨率 b ​ 50 b50 SENSE 图像进行相位对齐 Uecker et al. (2014) 。

paragraphs.en: The Dice term was calculated as the average over foreground classes present in each training window Milletari et al. (2016) . The voxel-mean categorical focal loss included background and used γ = 2 \gamma=2 Lin et al. (2017) . For VarNet-Seg and VarNet-Seg (no DC), the reconstruction loss was defined by the mean squared error between output magnitudes and the SENSE magnitudes of the augmented input with full sampling. Errors were normalized by the mean squared reference magnitude for each contrast and window within the segmentation crop, then averaged. For VarNet-Seg (frozen) and VarNet-Seg (frozen, no DC), reconstruction pretraining used this magnitude NMSE alone with weight 1 and no segmentation loss. Reconstruction checkpoint selection used fixed equispaced masks at R = 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 R=2,4,6,8 on the inner-validation patients, without added noise or spatial augmentation. Validation NMSE was averaged over windows within each patient, then over patients and accelerations, with equal weighting of both b b -values and exclusion of padded slices.
paragraphs.zh: Dice 项的计算方式是对每个训练窗口中存在的前景类取平均 Milletari et al. (2016)。 体素均值分类焦点损失包含背景，并使用 γ = 2 \gamma=2 Lin et al. (2017)。 对于 VarNet-Seg 和 VarNet-Seg (no DC)，重建损失定义为输出幅值与经过增强的全采样输入的 SENSE 幅值之间的均方误差。 误差按分割裁剪区域内每个对比度和窗口的参考幅值均方进行归一化，然后取平均。 对于 VarNet-Seg (frozen) 和 VarNet-Seg (frozen, no DC)，重建预训练仅使用该幅值 NMSE，权重为 1，且不使用分割损失。 重建检查点的选择在内层验证患者上使用固定的等间隔掩码，加速倍数为 R = 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 R=2,4,6,8，且不添加噪声或空间增强。 验证 NMSE 先在每个患者的窗口内取平均，再对患者和加速倍数取平均，两个 b b 值等权重，并排除填充切片。

paragraphs.en: After pretraining, all VarNet parameters, including residual scales and any active data-consistency weights, were frozen. A fresh segmentation U-Net was trained with the original segmentation sampling, augmentation and loss, without an auxiliary reconstruction loss. Each stage used the same optimizer and learning-rate schedule, a maximum of 100 epochs and early-stopping patience 30. Data consistency was enabled throughout both stages for VarNet-Seg (frozen) and disabled throughout both stages for VarNet-Seg (frozen, no DC). Outer-test patients were excluded from both stages’ fitting and checkpoint selection.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练之后，所有 VarNet 参数，包括残差缩放系数和所有启用的数据一致性权重，均被冻结。 使用原始分割采样、数据增强和损失函数训练了一个全新的分割 U-Net，不附加辅助重建损失。 每个阶段均使用相同的优化器和学习率调度，最多训练 100 个 epoch，早停耐心值为 30。 对于 VarNet-Seg (frozen)，数据一致性在两个阶段中始终启用；对于 VarNet-Seg (frozen, no DC)，数据一致性在两个阶段中始终禁用。 外部测试患者在两个阶段的拟合和检查点选择中均被排除。

paragraphs.en: Table S3 lists the sampling parameters. The central band was retained in addition to regularly spaced phase-encoding lines. Sampling patterns were shared across coils, contrasts and slices within an examination and across models. Noise-only experiments used SNRs from 30 to − 20 -20 dB in 5 dB steps. Combined experiments used undersampling factors 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 16 at SNRs of 20, 10 and 5 dB.
paragraphs.zh: 表 S3 列出了采样参数。 在等间隔相位编码线之外还保留了中心频带。 采样模式在检查内的各线圈、对比度和切片之间以及各模型之间是共享的。 仅噪声实验使用的信噪比从 30 到 − 20 -20 dB，步长为 5 dB。 组合实验使用的欠采样因子为 2、4、6、8、10、12 和 16，信噪比分别为 20、10 和 5 dB。

paragraphs.en: Confidence intervals were calculated from the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 10,000 patient bootstrap samples stratified by fold and highest reference grade Efron and Tibshirani (1994) . Two-sided tests compared VarNet-Seg–RSS-Seg differences with their null-centered bootstrap distribution, using an add-one correction. Comparisons were grouped by the panels in Figures 2a and 4b–d of the main manuscript and Figure S1 .
paragraphs.zh: 置信区间由按折数和最高参考分级分层的10,000次患者自助抽样（bootstrap）的第2.5和第97.5百分位数计算得出（Efron和Tibshirani，1994）。 采用双侧检验，将VarNet-Seg与RSS-Seg的差异与其零中心自助抽样分布进行比较，并使用了加一校正。 比较按主文稿图2a和图4b–d以及图S1中的面板进行分组。
